name: breakhis-uni-case-svm-v1
status: registered before case-SVC family fitting or validation scoring
question: Does a bounded nonlinear max-margin readout improve over its matched linear SVC control when both fit the actual case/mask target on the same frozen UNI2-h case-view means?
rationale: Training/validation field-surrogate generalization gap motivates a case-unit readout probe; nonlinear benefit and field diagnostic-label inadequacy remain hypotheses. No motivation or setting is chosen from the already viewed retrospective test gain of the prior specialist.

contextual_specialist_reference.status: fixed contextual reference only; its registered validation progression screen failed; no selection or fitting data

input_audit.policy: reuse exact parent roles, case order, field membership and original truth8/truth5; no new fold or seed

features.source: accepted frozen CLS field features; existing single center crop; no encoder forward or update
features.field_alignment: unique canonical relative_path bijection to the hash-bound original-image manifest, provider specimen, conservative group, original truth8, final truth5 and magnification; no cache-position zip
features.case_view_means: float64 arithmetic mean of all original field features within each provider case and each view

normalizer.scope: shared binary/malignant transform fitted once on exactly 49 TRAIN case-view means, with a separate mean and std per view and coordinate
normalizer.mean: elementwise population mean over the 49 TRAIN case means within each view
normalizer.std: elementwise population standard deviation over those same 49 TRAIN means; ddof=0
normalizer.small_std_rule: std < 1e-6 is replaced by 1.0; do not divide by 1e-6

fusion.sample_unit: one provider case and one nonempty available magnification subset
fusion.subset_order: increasing cardinality, then lexicographic combinations of view indices 0,1,2,3
fusion.sample_order: case-major in canonical role case order, then fixed subset order
fusion.view_transform: subtract fixed TRAIN per-view mean then divide by fixed TRAIN per-view replaced std
fusion.active_view_pooling: arithmetic mean of transformed vectors of active views only
fusion.availability_flags: append four binary active-view indicators multiplied by 0.5

svc.estimator: sklearn.svm.SVC for BOTH arms; linear is SVC(kernel=linear), not LinearSVC
svc.resolved_gamma: independently per head from unweighted fitting rows: 1/(1540*X.var(ddof=0)), with sklearn zero-variance fallback; save both resolved values for every candidate
svc.sample_weight_rule: exactly one factor 1/15 per TRAIN case/mask row; no second inverse-class factor
svc.internal_multiclass: Mal4 uses six one-versus-one binary problems; exposed OVR scores combine votes with transformed confidence, not four independently fitted OVR margins
svc.class_mass: sample weights total49 binary/35 malignant before class weighting; balanced effective total class mass49/2 and35/4 respectively

decision.binary: binary decision_function margin >= 0 routes malignant; exact zero ties are malignant
decision.malignant: first argmax of four exposed OVR decision scores in fixed DC,LC,MC,PC order
decision.score_transform: b=expit(binary margin); q=stable softmax of four OVR scores at fixed temperature1; joint=[1-b,b*q]
decision.score_interpretation: uncalibrated normalized scores, not fitted/calibrated probabilities; no internal probability CV or external calibration
decision.floating_route_guard: require transformed binary-score route and margin route to agree on evaluated records; otherwise fail closed rather than nudge a score or change the threshold

selection.metric: mean over all15 subsets of final-five macro F1 with fixed five labels
selection.seal: hash-seal BOTH selected arm candidates, every candidate/model/feature/normalizer/source/config/input receipt and successful validation reload guards before either selected retrospective test query

follow_up.role: unchanged already viewed 16-case role; retrospective reused-development follow-up only

artifacts: immutable source/archive/config and actual runtime receipts
exact parent result, contextual specialist, manifest/audit and cache pins
case-view means, normalizer mean/std/replaced scales and transformed TRAIN input hashes
all16 fitted head bundles and independent dense support-vector/dual/intercept exports with hashes
all8 validation margin/score archives, records and metrics
candidate validation save/reload margin guards before seal
both selected candidate seals and common family gate
only2 selected retrospective archives if execution completes
independent feature/margin/routing/selection/metric replay including every negative result

objectives.status: unmet objectives; not forecasts or promised outcomes
objectives.scope: all15-subset mean remains primary; no favorable subset or test-driven promotion

interpretation: One bounded standard frozen-feature readout comparison on reused development data. Case-unit fitting, normalization and readout differ from prior field/KDE pipelines; only the linear-versus-RBF contrast shares this exact package. Previous whole-case MIL and logistic negatives remain counterevidence. All original roles and prior results remain unchanged; no novel mechanism, clinical validation or guaranteed90/97 result. Stop at this registered budget; no automatic expansion after results.
